### Every Place Can Be a Thin Place - The Crosswalk Devotional - June 15
Author: Whitney Hopler
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/every-place-can-be-a-thin-place-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 3:16
Points:
- Believers do not need a secluded or physical holy site to encounter God because His Spirit lives in them.
- Being the temple of God means carrying His sacred presence into every ordinary moment of daily life.
- Recognizing God's indwelling presence challenges Christians to live holy lives in thoughts, words, and conduct.
- Seeing other believers as dwelling places of the Spirit inspires treating them with honor, respect, and kindness.
- True spiritual connection comes from intentionally practicing awareness of God's presence everywhere we go.

### Who Is the Real Fool? - Love Worth Finding - September 19
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-september-19-2020.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 3:18
Points:
- Worldly perspectives regularly dismiss authentic devotion and praise toward God as foolishness.
- Believers should not be discouraged when secular culture mocks their commitment to Christ.
- True biblical wisdom requires a willingness to appear foolish in the eyes of the world.
- Walking faithfully with the Lord means unashamedly embracing the identity of fools for Christ's sake.
